Maria G.: Good evening — I'm taking over oncall. Quick handoff:
- Deploys: frontend v3.5.1 rolled at 21:00 UTC (canary). Watch eu-west canary for increased error rate.
- Runtime change: KV cache eviction tuning pushed to staging earlier today (eviction threshold lowered). Expect more cold starts for short-lived keys.
- Routing: new fallback policy (cost-prefer) was enabled for low-priority traffic; route id: deployments/382.
- Alerts: synthetic "generate-text" probe started intermittently failing (~0.5% of runs) since ~20:45 UTC; proxy returning 502 in some traces.
- Ticket: INF-765 created for the probe failures (linked in the ticketing thread). Assigned to Vikram.
- Watch thresholds: if regional queue depth > 200 (eu-west or us-central) — disable canary and escalate to infra.
- Contact: slack ping @Maria G. or call if escalation needed.

Vikram S.: Acknowledged. Looking at INF-765 now. Initial suspicion is transient gRPC connection pool exhaustion between proxy and runtime. I increased pool size on the canary at 22:10 UTC and restarted the proxy.

Cheng (oncall): Saw the synthetic errors too. After Vikram's pool bump the error rate in the canary dropped to ~0.1% over the last 15m.
Note on KV eviction: threshold change was 1h -> 30m, so expect a higher 1st-token latency for embeddings for cold keys. If first-token latency > 300ms consistently, enable prewarmers for the affected routes.

Katie: I'll review PR #4525 (embed-prefetch) now. If tests pass I'll merge — should help with those coldstarts. ETA ~30m.

Maria G.: Thanks. Small ask — if anyone sees queue depth creeping up or 5xxs > 1% sustained for 5m, flip canary and notify infra. I'll update the runbook with the new eviction threshold and the prewarm recommendation.

oncall-bot: :robot_face: Deploy bot: canary rollback policy armed — rollback if error rate > 1% for 5m (automatic).

Vikram S.: Quick note: no planned infra maintenance tonight. There's a kernel update scheduled for 03/12 but outside oncall window. I'll add a monitoring dashboard annotation for the pool change.

Cheng (oncall): I'll keep an eye on embeddings latency and the synthetic probe. If error rate resurges I'll reopen INF-765 with traces.

Maria G.: Action items: Vikram to monitor INF-765 and the canary; Cheng to watch embeddings coldstart metrics and synthetic probe; Katie to merge PR #4525 and ping when done. I'll push a small runbook update and pin this thread. Thanks everyone — handing off now.

Katie: merged PR #4525 at 22:38 UTC, tests green. Notifying here so you can unmute the prewarm alert if it triggers. :thumbsup:
